assay: bulk stranded mRNA-seq, 76-bp single-end, HiSeq; human vastus lateralis needle biopsies (S2.2.p1)
design: 13 subjects (BR-CON n=6: 5M+1F; BR-EX n=7: 5M+2F), biopsy pre and post 35-day -6 deg head-down-tilt bed rest; BR-EX did rowing ergometry 6 d/wk + biweekly resistance training (S2.1.p1, TAB1, S2.2.p1)

factors.subject: 13 subjects, each sampled pre and post

sample_inclusion: all 26 libraries (13 subjects x 2) in the unblinded DESeq2 analysis of 'male and female subjects' (S3.2.p1); females were excluded only from the blinded analysis (S2.4.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-group change post-bed-rest vs baseline, separately in BR-CON and BR-EX (nested design, paired within subject); the exercise effect is read as the contrast between these two responses (1352 vs 132 DEGs) (S2.5.p1, S3.2.p1, ABS.p1)
planned_contrasts: BR-CON post vs pre, paired within subject (S3.2.p1; paper: 1352 DEGs, 591 up / 761 down)
BR-EX post vs pre, paired within subject (S3.2.p1; paper: 132 DEGs, 69 up / 63 down)
repeated_measure_unit: subject (pre and post biopsy from the same volunteer; S2.5.p1 'Pairing was done for within-subject pre- and post-biopsies')
normalization: STAR GeneCounts -> DESeq2 counts model; StringTie TPM re-normalized over protein-coding genes used for blinded analysis and gene filter (S2.3.p3, S2.5.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2, nested design (group-specific condition effects, subject nested in group), BH-adjusted p (S2.5.p1)
enrichment: Enrichr GO BP on up and down DEG sets per group (S2.5.p1, TAB3, TAB4)
